boundaries: Owned local H5/createApp/JWT/PG16/memoryR2; synthetic account and history/session/route controls and navigation chrome. No real login/device/production provider or storage proof
14-table/all-sequence native snapshots and independently observed concurrent row lock waits. ORM fixture lacks full production indexes/FKs/triggers/ACL; no production role permission proof
State uses short same-transaction FOR SHARE and pure access predicate without browse. Not SQL READ ONLY/RR; site config KV cache may fill while DB/sequences remain unchanged
detail is a compatibility GET with exact browse write and share is a compatibility GET with exact share counter write; other browser API reads preserve all rows/sequences

Browser proves actual H5 clipboard and authenticated11/22 intents; anonymous copy/materials, MP materials and App provider callbacks verified via actual Vue/native-I/O runtime mocks only, no device delivery claim
Share counter means admitted explicit intent after H5/native success or MP material hook, not recipient delivery; anonymous public sharing does not call auth-required counter endpoint
Unknown markers survive composable destruction and close/reopen only within same auth store in memory; no reload/new-session persistence claim; invalid/5xx/transport responses never auto replay
Existing duplicate canonical author profile counter update policy retained; no schema/dependency changes. UniApp inherited raw npm audit82 entries and strict reviewed gate/six Vite backports remain
Local Node24.19.0/npm11.7.0 differs from CI pinned Node24.14.1/npm11.11.0
